Unix was originally developed in New Jer.why: Rarely stated. Every exact form of the direct fact tried is absent from Dolma, and the Unix article (and the Unix articles of de, fr and es Wikipedia, checked by the scouting review) never names New Jersey or Murray Hill. It follows from Unix being developed at Bell Labs, Bell Labs being at Murray Hill, New Jersey, and the work being done there. Not very_likely: the Bell Labs article's facilities list places "UNIX operating system" at the Murray Hill, NJ site, a near-direct statement in one table row, and a few hundred Unix documents have "Murray Hill, New Jersey" nearby (264 approximate, about 1.2% of the Unix-Bell Labs co-occurrences; the sampled ones are citations of Bell Labs reports and a definition list, not statements of the fact). FOLDOC's Bell Labs entry gives the same near-direct link through the site (cited under the site premise).
